title: Filipino-Style Vegetable Pinakbet Pasta
description: A fusion dish that combines the Filipino flavors of pinakbet with the Italian classic linguine pasta.

ingredients.name: oozy sauce
ingredients.notes: such as a garlic butter sauce

instructions: Cook the linguine pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the oozy sauce over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and sauté until softened.
Add the diced tangy tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the pinakbet and cook for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Combine the cooked linguine pasta with the vegetable mixture and toss to combine.
